title: Earthquake damage, San Fernando Valley, 1971 – U-2 aerial photo of collapsed freeway
description: High-contrast aerial photograph of a freeway interchange with collapsed overpass sections and curving ramps. Captioned "Earthquake damage, San Fernando Valley, 1971." Chapter 5 text (page 255) mentions domestic U-2 missions for federal agencies such as COMPASS TRIP and begins the section "Overseas Deployment Exercises and Missions" (SCOPE SAINT); part of the text is redacted.
